configurePresets.name: dev
configurePresets.description: Optimized like a release build but without the whole-program link, which dominates the turnaround of a one-file change. Use this for iteration; use 'release' to reproduce what ships.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: -Wall -Wextra -pedantic and the verbose logging paths. Slow at run time; this is the configuration to reproduce a crash in, not to benchmark in.

configurePresets.name: release
configurePresets.description: Matches the wheel/conda configuration, LTO included. Benchmark numbers in PERF.md are taken here.

configurePresets.name: lib-only
configurePresets.description: Skips the SWIG wrappers entirely. tttrlibPYTHON_wrap.cxx is a single ~180k-line translation unit and is fully serial, so it is the longest pole in any incremental build; when a change does not touch the interface, this is the fastest way to know whether it compiles.

configurePresets.name: no-hdf5
configurePresets.displayName: Developer build without the HDF5 reader
configurePresets.description: Drops the only HDF5 consumer, so HighFive and the HDF5 headers leave the compile line. Useful when working on anything other than Photon-HDF5 I/O.
